news_cards.title: Bihar Government School Routine Change
bullets: The Bihar government is set to change the Saturday routine in government schools.
A notification regarding the change will be issued soon.
This change is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it reflects the government's efforts to improve the education system in Bihar.

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Development
bullets: The JP Ganga Path will be developed to have a world-class infrastructure.
A 65-kilometer Ganga channel will be developed as part of the project.
This development is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it showcases the government's focus on infrastructure development in Bihar.

news_cards.title: Bihar Civil Services Exam 2025
bullets: The results of the Bihar Civil Services Exam 2025 have been announced.
The exam saw participation from many young candidates from Bihar.
This exam is directly relevant to the BPSC exam as it is a key recruitment exam for government services in Bihar.

news_cards.title: Nasha Mukti Abhiyan in Bihar
bullets: The Bihar government has launched a Nasha Mukti Abhiyan to combat drug addiction.
The campaign aims to create awareness and provide support for those affected by drug addiction.
This initiative is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the government's efforts to address social issues in Bihar.

news_cards.title: Bihar State Cooperative Bank Modernization
bullets: The Bihar State Cooperative Bank will be modernized to improve its services.
The bank will be made more efficient and customer-friendly.
This modernization is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it reflects the government's efforts to improve the banking sector in Bihar.

news_cards.title: RERA Bihar Regulatory Authority
bullets: The RERA Bihar Regulatory Authority will be made more transparent and digital.
The authority will prioritize the interests of homebuyers.
This development is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the government's efforts to regulate the real estate sector in Bihar.

news_cards.title: Patna Metro Construction
bullets: The construction of the Patna Metro is underway.
The project aims to improve the transportation infrastructure in Patna.
This development is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it showcases the government's focus on urban development in Bihar.

news_cards.title: Integrated Steel Project in Gaya
bullets: An integrated steel project worth Rs 6,000 crore will be set up in Gaya.
The project will be developed by the Mahashakti Group.
This development is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the government's efforts to promote industrial growth in Bihar.
